body.name: Nondegenerate polynomial witness
body.construction: For \(t\in[0,1/10]\), generate the full law \(P_t^{\mathrm F,w}\) by the declared affine propensity, affine baseline, affine CATE, conditionally independent Bernoulli potential outcomes, and consistency; set \(P_t^{\mathrm w}=\operatorname{Obs}(P_t^{\mathrm F,w})\).
